about.heading: About Evidence Pilot
about.desc: Evidence Pilot is a supervised research workspace that connects source collection, collaborative paper authoring, citation review, instructor feedback, and export. AI and semantic search assist the workflow while people remain responsible for academic decisions.

terms.intro: Welcome to Evidence Pilot. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
terms.section1: By using Evidence Pilot, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms. We may update these terms from time to time; continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
terms.section2: Evidence Pilot provides an AI-assisted research management platform including document upload and extraction, collaborative paper authoring, citation review, instructor feedback workflows, and semantic search. The Service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind.
terms.section3p1: Evidence Pilot uses artificial intelligence to analyze paper sections and generate citation findings, related-source matches, and writing suggestions. These outputs are advisory only. They do not constitute verified academic conclusions, nor do they replace the researcher's own judgment, expertise, and responsibility.
terms.section3p2: You acknowledge and agree that all AI-generated suggestions must be reviewed, validated, and edited by a qualified human researcher before being incorporated into any academic work, submission, or publication. Final decisions regarding research content, methodology, and conclusions remain solely your responsibility.
terms.section4: Evidence Pilot is provided as a research assistance tool. We make no guarantees regarding the accuracy, completeness, or suitability of AI-generated outputs for any specific academic purpose. We shall not be held liable for any issues, rejections, or deficiencies in your research papers, theses, dissertations, or any other academic work, including but not limited to: plagiarism findings, factual errors, citation mistakes, methodological flaws, or any adverse academic outcomes resulting from the use of or reliance on our platform's suggestions. Use the platform with caution and apply your own critical judgment at every step.
terms.section5: You are responsible for: (a) the accuracy and legality of all content you upload; (b) maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials; (c) ensuring your use complies with your institution's academic integrity policies; and (d) reviewing and validating all AI-generated outputs before use.
terms.section6: You retain all rights to the research content, documents, and data you upload. Evidence Pilot claims no ownership over your work. We may use anonymized, aggregated data for service improvement.
terms.section7: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms or engage in abusive behavior. You may delete your account at any time.
terms.section8: For questions about these Terms, please contact our support team.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Evidence Pilot collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal information when you use our platform.
privacy.section1: We collect information you provide directly: name, email address, institutional affiliation, and account credentials. We also collect content you upload, including documents, paper sections, source metadata, feedback, and project metadata. Automatically collected data includes usage logs, IP addresses, browser type, and interaction analytics.
privacy.section2: We use your information to: provide and improve the Service, process document extraction and Citation Review, enable instructor feedback workflows, communicate service updates, and ensure platform security. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.section3: Your data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption. Documents are stored in object storage (MinIO), structured data in databases (MySQL), and vector embeddings in Qdrant. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.
privacy.section4: We integrate with: OpenAlex API for DOI-based paper metadata retrieval, and an external AI service for document analysis. These services receive only the data necessary for their function and are contractually bound to protect your information.
privacy.section5: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time. Backup data may be retained for up to 90 days after deletion.
privacy.section6: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to: access, correct, or delete your personal data; restrict or object to processing; and receive a portable copy of your data. To exercise these rights, contact our support team.
privacy.section7: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. No third-party tracking cookies are used for advertising purposes.
privacy.section8: We may update this Privacy Policy. Material changes will be notified via email or platform notice.
privacy.section9: For privacy-related inquiries, please contact our support team.

aboutPage.missionDesc: Evidence Pilot was created to connect source collection with academic evaluation. The platform gives instructors and assigned students a structured environment for paper authoring, citation review, feedback, and revision.
aboutPage.storyDesc: Born from the challenges faced by students and supervisors in evidence-based research projects, Evidence Pilot evolved into a focused workspace for document extraction, semantic search, citation review, structured feedback, and revision.
aboutPage.techDesc: Evidence Pilot is built on a modern technology stack: Java 21 with Spring Boot for the backend, React 19 with Vite for the frontend, MySQL for structured data, MinIO for file storage, Qdrant for vector search, and RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing. AI capabilities are powered by an integrated service for Citation Review and section suggestions.
aboutPage.teamDesc: Evidence Pilot is designed around the current instructor-led project workflow and will continue to improve from verified user feedback and academic requirements.
